decision_basis: IL-27 receptor-complex signaling through IL27RA/IL6ST with JAK/STAT and context-dependent MAPK/Akt outputs supports qualified-high relay/function evidence; the heterodimeric IL-27 ligand is retained and isolated EBI3 activity is not claimed.

EDN1/EDNRA Gq/PLC/PKC and ERK1/2 signaling with smooth-muscle contractile or proliferative outputs supports qualified-high exact relay/function evidence; tissue and antagonist-specificity boundaries remain explicit.

EDN1/EDNRB receptor signaling with G-protein/PKC and ERK1/2 outputs in the defined melanocyte model supports qualified-high exact relay/function evidence; EDNRA co-usage and cell-type dependence remain explicit.
EDN2/EDNRA dependence with contractile ovarian and retinal vascular outputs supports qualified-high exact relay/function evidence; tissue, species, and endpoint-specific boundaries remain explicit.

Membrane-associated ephrin-A1 engagement and clustering of EphA2 with Src/Rho-actomyosin and focal-adhesion outputs support qualified-high exact relay/function evidence in tumor or engineered receptor systems; avidity and model context remain explicit.

EFNA1/EphA8 binding and receptor phosphorylation in receptor-chimera and NIH3T3 systems support qualified-high receptor-proximal evidence; downstream adaptor, terminal-TF, and native-cell extrapolation are excluded.
